supportingSources.label: Pinrepair Bank-A-Ball and Flipper Pool rules and mechanism guide

strategy.overview: Bank-A-Ball and Flipper Pool record the numbered pool balls you collect in an animated backglass. On Bank-A-Ball, collect either 1–7 or 9–15 to light the center 8-ball; hitting the lit 8-ball lights a rollover for Special. The practical route is to shoot upward through the bumpers, nudge for missing-number rollovers, and challenge a stand-up only when it completes a needed group.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Bank-A-Ball and Flipper Pool, send the ball through the bumpers and collect missing numbered pool balls. On Bank-A-Ball, completing 1–7 or 9–15 lights the center 8-ball; hitting the lit 8-ball lights a rollover for Special. Flipper Pool replaces replay awards with Add-A-Balls, so check the setup before chasing the final numbers.
strategy.summary: Favor upward shots and nudge toward uncollected numbers. Do not fire at a dangerous stand-up merely for five points; take it when it completes a group or Add-A-Ball. Use return lanes to preserve control and relight bumpers where the variant permits.

steps.text: Plunge or shoot upward through the bumpers and nudge toward a numbered lane that is still missing.
Favor 1–7 or 9–15 as a group according to which side already has more collected numbers.
Shoot a stand-up only when it safely completes a missing number or a valuable group.
On Bank-A-Ball, complete either group to light the center 8-ball, then hit it to light a Special rollover.
Return to upward shots and guide the ball through the lit rollover rather than forcing it from an uncontrolled feed.

buildsToward.title: A completed pool-ball group and lit award rollover

steps.text: Collect either all solids, 1–7, or all stripes, 9–15.
Collect the lit rollover for Special or the variant's configured award.

editionDifferences.pro: Bank-A-Ball is the replay version: complete a numbered group, hit the lit 8-ball, then collect the lit rollover for Special.
editionDifferences.premium: Flipper Pool is the Add-A-Ball version: collected-number thresholds and the last pool balls award extra balls instead of replay credits.

machineSetup: Identify Bank-A-Ball or Flipper Pool before play, then confirm Special or Add-A-Ball conversion, award thresholds, and whether the backglass pool-ball unit resets after a completed rack.

Test all 15 numbered switches and backglass balls, center 8-ball target and lamp, both award rollovers, bumpers and their light controls, both return lanes, reset coils, and the wide center-drain feed.
